Name: Lord Dante, The Pale Titan

Voice: Gregor Clegane, tuff dude, simple words, "Fuck the knights, fuck the king, and fuck the gods."

Description: gigantic mountain of a man, standing at a 7ft tall, rippled and bulging muscles under a steel helmet. Always carries a sword on his back and a hammer on his hip. He never removes his helmet. 

Important Info: Lord of the castle Whitestone, strongest man in [[Estor]], most dangerous mortal to duel in the 4 Kingdoms, fought [[Characters/People/Tyran]] to a stalemate in a wrestling match. Owns a belt of Fire Giant Strength
